notes: Route: React.lazy analytics chunk added to router.tsx at path 'analytics' under /x children. AppLayout.tsx gains FleetAdmin-gated NavLink to /x/analytics with t('nav.analytics') = 'Analytika' (cs). AppLayout.test.tsx verifies the gating: Analytika shown for FleetAdmin, absent for Dispatcher, absent for null role.

Chunk naming: Default Rollup would name the chunk AnalyticsPage-[hash].js, missing the size-limit glob. Added build.rollupOptions.output.manualChunks in vite.config.ts returning 'analytics' for /features/analytics/ + /chart.js/ + /react-chartjs-2/ module IDs. Chunk is now dist/assets/analytics-*.js.

Budget: WI-12 provisional 75 KB was too low. Measured 86.3 KB brotli after routing and Overview tab land (chart.js Line controller ~55-60 KB + tab code ~25 KB). Budget raised to 90 KB in web/package.json with docs/decisions.md entry explaining the adjustment. Eager bundle: 214.78 KB brotli (well under 260 KB). chart.js confirmed absent from eager index.js.

AnalyticsPage tab shell: 6 tabs (Přehled/Poptávka/Provoz/Tržby/Řidiči/Zákazníci) rendered as role=tab buttons. Local useState manages active tab. Only Přehled renders OverviewTab; others render placeholder text. AnalyticsControls wired with local state (preset/granularity/compare → overviewParams passed to OverviewTab).

OverviewTab: 11 KPI cards via definition list (<dl>/<dt>/<dd>), delta badges (green/red with +/- prefix), Chart.js Line chart via overviewChart.ts pure config builder, screen-reader-only <table> fallback, empty state when series is empty, error state on fetch failure.
overviewChart.ts: pure config builder (no React imports), dual-axis Line chart (rides left y-axis, revenue right y-axis). Unit tested in isolation without canvas.

chartMock.ts updated: stubs now include role='img' to satisfy axe aria-prohibited-attr rule on divs with aria-label. OverviewTab.test.tsx and AnalyticsPage.test.tsx both dogfood chartMockModule via async dynamic import: vi.mock('react-chartjs-2', async () => { const { chartMockModule } = await import('../charts/chartMock'); return chartMockModule() }). This avoids TDZ (vi.mock is hoisted before imports) while reusing the shared helper.

theme.ts + theme.d.ts: added textOnPrimary: '#ffffff' token. Used in AnalyticsControls GranularityButton and CompareButton active state instead of the hardcoded '#ffffff' string. Semantically correct vs. using 'surface' which is a background token.
data-testid='granularity-group' removed from AnalyticsControls GranularityGroup (redundant per review — role='group' + aria-label already provide accessible identity).

Print stylesheet: analyticsPrint.css imported in AnalyticsPage.tsx (ships only in analytics chunk). @media print rules: hide header/controls (.analytics-toolbar class), A4 @page, KPI grid 3-col, hide canvas, show sr-only table.
